meta.name: feedback
meta.description: Assess a field lesson for reuse or product feedback without exposing customer context. Use for recurring deployment lessons; distinguish a hypothesis from a validated pattern.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 甄别一线复盘经验,区分假设与已验证做法,安全回流产品反馈。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果团队反复踩同样的坑,想把一线经验沉淀成可复用结论又不泄露客户信息。
copy.tagline_en: Turn field lessons into reusable patterns or safe product feedback.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team keeps relearning the same lessons and must feed them back safely.

howto.what: Claude 会评估一条现场经验（field lesson），判断它该被复用到别处还是转成产品反馈，过程中不暴露客户上下文，并把「假设」与「已验证的模式」区分开。
howto.when: 当你处理反复出现的部署经验，需要判断它是假设还是已验证模式、或要转成产品反馈时接管；若由 @fde 调用，会沿用其已脱敏的数据包与范围。

say.text: 帮我评估这段部署经验：该复用还是转成产品反馈？
say.note: 会先读任务上下文契约和方法再评估。

say.text: 把这条经验整理成脱敏后的模式记录。
say.note: 保留未知项，不暴露客户信息。

say.text: 这是假设还是已验证的模式？请区分。
say.note: 会指出哪些部分尚未验证。

howto.what_en: Claude assesses a field lesson to decide whether it is reusable or should become product feedback, without exposing customer context, and separates a hypothesis from a validated pattern.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you work on recurring deployment lessons and need to tell a hypothesis from a validated pattern, or turn one into product feedback; when called by @fde it reuses its sanitized packet.

say_en.text: Assess this deployment lesson: reusable, or product feedback?
say_en.note: Reads the task context contract and method first.

say_en.text: Turn this lesson into a sanitized pattern record.
Is this a hypothesis or a validated pattern?
say_en.note: Points out what is still unverified.
